name: Haiku quality compounders
strategy: Concentrated portfolio of highest-quality US businesses with strong competitive moats, high ROIC, and fortress balance sheets. Heavy positioning in AI-driven software and semiconductors, paired with ecosystem platforms and premium financial services. Emphasis on companies that compound earnings at high rates through pricing power and capital efficiency.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This portfolio concentrates on the highest-quality businesses by fundamental metrics: Microsoft and Amazon dominate cloud/enterprise; Nvidia leads semiconductor AI; Google and Meta own ad/platform moats; Apple commands consumer ecosystem lock-in; Visa operates a recession-resistant payment network; JPMorgan represents best-in-class banking; Costco compounds through membership model; Berkshire diversifies and anchors quality. All demonstrate high ROIC, strong balance sheets, and AI tailwinds positioning them to outperform the broader S&P 500 over the next 6 months.
